content: The R. Iʿtiqādiyya is a very brief statement of creed in the form of a letter, in which Ibn Turka justifies his wide learning in youth, including sciences at odds with Sunni principles, by the hadith 'learn even sorcery', comparing himself to Ghazālī and Fakhr al-Dīn Rāzī, and says that whatever he has carried over from the formulations of the Sufi masters does not touch matters of creed; like several of his letters it is signed kamtarīn-i fuqarā, Ṣāʾin-i Turka.
